newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gentex Corp estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gentex Corp estimates cut.

text.p: -- Mesirow Financial said Monday it reduced its estimates for Gentex Corp's earnings in fiscal 1996 and fiscal 1997 to reflect lower gross margin assumptions.

-- Mesirow lowered its estimate for fiscal 1996 to $0.19 from $0.21 a share to reflect a longer holiday shutdown than expected and the effects of a strike at General Motors Corp. Mesirow added that its revenue assumption for 1997 remains essentially unchanged at $150.9 million.
-- The earnings estimate for fiscal 1997 has been lowered to $0.95 from $1.00 to reflect mirror price reductions specified in Gentex's long-term supply contracts.
-- Gentex makes mirrors for automobile manufacturers.
-- Its shares were up 1/4 Monday at 19-3/4.
